preregistration.expectation: One fixed task (vault_lookup custom tool returning a random value, a long-essay turn interrupted mid-stream, then a new-process resume asking for the stored value) runs through both SDKs against the same local model and provider. The Codex SDK registers the tool as a thread dynamicTool; the Claude Agent SDK registers it through create_sdk_mcp_server. Both are scored on the checklist carried over from round 1: structured events typed, custom-tool round trip, mid-turn interrupt status, resume recall in a new process.
criteria: custom-tool round trip: the host-side handler is called with key alpha and the model's final answer contains the handler's value
interrupt: the SDK reports an interrupted/aborted terminal state and the provider shows the request ended (num_requests_running 0)
resume: a new OS process resumes the same thread/session id and returns the turn-1 value without calling the tool (a decoy handler value must not appear)
structured events: every received event is a typed SDK object (Codex: not UnknownNotification; Claude: SDK message classes)
settled only if both SDKs complete all four items on the same task; model-quality failures of the small local model are recorded as such and leave the gap advanced
scope stated in the receipt: SDK-level comparison with one open-weight model; hosted gpt/claude models are not part of this arm
